summary: Checks whether a value is an array.
description: `Array.isArray` is the whole test, so an array from another frame counts and an array-like object — `arguments`, a `NodeList`, `{ length: 0 }` — does not.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).
returns: `true` when the value is an array; otherwise `false`.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
isArray([]); // => true
isArray([1, 2, 3]); // => true
isArray("abc"); // => false
isArray({ length: 0 }); // => false
isArray(null); // => false
```
